background: Barclays Bank PLC is the non-ring-fenced bank of Barclays, housing the corporate and investment bank, the international cards business and the private bank, funded by corporate deposits and wholesale markets.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, all three on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. The balance sheet is the weaker side of UK majors on every measure: CET1 of 12.6% and NSFR of 112% are in the bottom quarter, and leverage of 4.6% and LCR of 140% are below the peer median. LCR has fallen 14 points since 30 Jun 2025, while the other ratios have held flat. The ratings rest on the wider group rather than on this entity's ratios.
